title: RDS Instance Publicly Accessible
rag_framework: AWS Well-Architected Framework - Security Pillar, CIS AWS Foundations Benchmark v5.0.0
llm_guidance:
RDS instance is publicly accessible, exposing it to potential brute-force and exploitation attempts.
Update the RDS instance to use a VPC endpoint or an interface VPC endpoint, and ensure that the RDS instance is not publicly accessible by setting publicly_accessible to False in the RDS instance configuration.

title: RDS Instance Publicly Accessible
rag_framework: AWS Well-Architected Framework - Security Pillar, CIS AWS Foundations Benchmark v5.0.0
llm_guidance:
RDS instances are publicly accessible, exposing them to brute-force and exploitation attempts.
Update the RDS instance configuration to set PubliclyAccessible to 'false' and ensure RDS storage encryption is enabled using AWS KMS, then update the parameter group to require SSL/TLS for client connections by setting require_secure_transport to '1'.

title: EC2 instance does not allow ingress from the Internet to TCP port 22 (SSH)
llm_guidance:
An EC2 instance's SSH port is exposed to the internet, allowing unauthorized access.
Restrict inbound SSH access to the EC2 instance by updating its security group to only allow connections from a trusted IP address, VPN CIDR range, or a bastion host, and ensure HttpTokens is set to required to enforce IMDSv2.

title: Storage Account Reachable From Any Network
rag_framework: ISO/IEC 27001:2022 Annex A - Technological Controls, Microsoft Cloud Security Benchmark
llm_guidance:
Unauthorized access to sensitive data could lead to data breaches.
Update the Azure Storage account to restrict network access by setting publicNetworkAccess to Disabled, and configure a firewall to only allow access from trusted VNets or IP addresses.
